_comment: GLOBAL HOUSE-STYLE BLOCK for all generated campaign illustrations. Split into two layers. The GLOBAL_MEDIUM layer rides VERBATIM on every prompt (plates, scenes, composites) and governs rendering medium, format, lighting philosophy, and material honesty — it is what makes every image feel like one campaign. The WORLD_PALETTE layer is the muted-earthy color/wear philosophy; it applies to environment-grounded characters (e.g. Garland) but YIELDS to a character's own canonical palette when they have a strong defined one (e.g. Roderic the shining paladin). For those characters, use the character's canon palette in place of WORLD_PALETTE and trim the palette-specific entries from 'avoid'. House style governs medium/format/light/material; per-character canon files govern identity and (for strong-palette characters) color.

GLOBAL_MEDIUM._comment: Rides verbatim on EVERY prompt regardless of character. This is the consistency anchor.
GLOBAL_MEDIUM.medium: Painterly photoreal concept art with a documentary, grounded tone; soft visible brushwork over realistic form; obsessive material-wear and material-honesty detail (worked metal with weight and subtle edge wear, real dyed cloth, creased leather, weathered stone, lived-in surfaces); human-scale, anti-glamour, not a hero painting and not a glossy CGI render
GLOBAL_MEDIUM.format_for_plates: Full-body character reference plate: single subject centered, full body in frame with breathing room around it, settled natural weight, calm candid un-posed bearing, no action or battle tension; seamless neutral mid-gray studio backdrop with a slight natural vignette, no set or environment; portrait 2:3 aspect ratio. For humanoid subjects: front-facing, full body head to feet, headroom above and floor space below. For non-humanoid subjects (animals, druid wild-shapes, creatures): render at a believable real-world scale rather than filling the frame — a small creature sits on the implied studio floor occupying only the lower/central portion with empty backdrop around and above it, with an explicit size cue so scale reads correctly. Animal forms stay grounded and anatomically real, never cartoonish or anthropomorphized.
GLOBAL_MEDIUM.lighting_for_plates: Soft, even, diffuse front studio light; low contrast, gentle falloff, flat enough to read every material clearly; no colored light, no hard spotlight, no dramatic shafts or rim lighting
GLOBAL_MEDIUM.lighting_for_scenes: Diffuse atmospheric practical light — hazy overcast or low muted golden-hour glow filtered through dust and cloud; soft volumetric god-rays only in sacred interiors; low contrast, no crisp spotlighting on people
GLOBAL_MEDIUM.tone: Grounded, candid, human-scale; subjects settled and un-posed; honor the weight and craft of real materials over spectacle; endurance and dignity without glamour
GLOBAL_MEDIUM.signature_items: A character's named or signature gear (a blade, a piece of armor, a relic, a focus) is rendered with material honesty and individual character — pattern-welded or worked steel may show its grain, edge, forging marks and honest wear as believable real metal; relics and foci may carry their canonical detail. This characterful, worked, matte-to-satin treatment is explicitly distinct from and does NOT override the forbidden mirror-polish/CGI-gloss. Make signature items read as real, made, used objects with weight and history, not glamour props.
avoid_global: dramatic rim lighting or crisp high-contrast cinematic spotlighting on people
model-handsome idealized faces that drift from the character's reference
heroic mid-action posing on reference plates

WORLD_PALETTE._comment: Default color/wear layer for environment-grounded characters (Garland-type). OMIT or REPLACE with a character canon palette for strong-palette characters (Roderic-type). When omitted, also drop the palette/wear entries from avoid_palette.
palette: tarnished amber-gold, never bright or gleaming
dull matte steel and old iron
sun-bleached sage and faded muted green
WORLD_PALETTE.wear_philosophy: Heavily traveled and mended; nothing new or matching; faded grandeur worn down at its working surfaces
WORLD_PALETTE.tone_overlay: Post-imperial melancholy; faded grandeur outlived by the small, tired people in its shadow; weary endurance
avoid_palette: glossy mirror-polish or pristine gleaming armor/metal
clean matching equipment with no wear
youthful vigor where age and wear belong

_usage.grounded_character_example_garland: Apply GLOBAL_MEDIUM + WORLD_PALETTE in full. Garland IS the world palette.
_usage.strong_palette_character_example_roderic: Apply GLOBAL_MEDIUM in full. REPLACE WORLD_PALETTE with Roderic's canon palette (bright polished silver-steel, warm gold detailing, deep heraldic blue, gold rampant lion on blue shield). Do NOT include avoid_palette entries — his brightness is canonical identity, not a style violation.
_usage.rule_of_thumb: GLOBAL_MEDIUM is never negotiable; it is the campaign's visual signature. WORLD_PALETTE is a default that strong-identity characters override with their own canon colors. The medium keeps the cast coherent even when their palettes differ.
